Firefox includes a built-in password management feature. To manage your stored logins and passwords:
#Click the menu button [[Image:Fx89menuButton]] to open the menu panel.
#[[Template:openlockwise70]]
The Firefox ''about:logins'' page will open. From here, you'll be able to [[Add a login with the Firefox Password Manager|add]] or manage logins and passwords.

See [[Password Manager - Remember, delete and edit logins and passwords in Firefox]] for more information.
